info.title: ProjectBase API
info.description: High-performance, ultra-lightweight Plane & Linear alternative for multi-project Kanban, sprint cycles, and autonomous AI agent orchestration.

get.description: Returns the ordered list of custom field definitions for a project (Linear-style properties). Field types: text, number, select, checkbox, date.

put.description: Replaces the full ordered list of custom field definitions for a project. Labels/options capped at 120 chars, max 50 fields.

post.description: Validates a proposed custom_fields payload against the project's definitions. Returns 200 valid or 422 with an error string.

get.description: Returns the resolved outgoing relations (blocks / blocked_by / related) plus every incoming mirror edge for an issue.

200.description: Relations with resolved target issue details

post.description: Links two issues (blocks / blocked_by / related). The reciprocal edge is mirrored automatically (A blocks B <=> B blocked_by A).

delete.description: Removes a relation edge and its reciprocal mirror.

post.description: Bulk-create issues from an array of row objects. Rows map loosely to issue fields (title, description, status, priority, assignee, due_date, estimate, labels, source_key). Idempotent on matching titles/source keys.

post.summary: Import Issues from a GitHub Repository
post.description: Fetch issues from a public (or PAT-authenticated) GitHub repo and import them into a project. Idempotent: keyed by GitHub issue number via source_metadata.source_key. Optionally passes a GitHub Personal Access Token for private repos.

token.description: Optional GitHub PAT for private repos

400.description: Missing project_id, invalid repo, or >5000 max_issues

post.summary: Import Issues from a Linear Export
post.description: Import issues from a Linear workspace export. Accepts either an array of row objects keyed by Linear's workspace-export CSV columns (ID, Title, Status, Priority, Labels, Assignee, Due Date, Estimate, Description, Parent issue) via `rows`, or the raw CSV export text via `csv`. Idempotent: keyed by Linear issue ID via source_metadata.source_key.

rows.description: Row objects keyed by Linear export column names

csv.description: Raw Linear workspace CSV export text (pasted directly). Parsed server-side.

400.description: Missing project_id / empty rows / too many rows

get.description: Download a project's issues as a machine-readable JSON document. Mirrors the importer fields so an exported file can be re-imported elsewhere.

Download a project's issues as a CSV attachment. Header mirrors the importer columns (title,description,status,priority,assignee,start_date,due_date,estimate,labels,source_key,custom_fields) so the file can be re-imported.

post.description: Marks every unread notification for the current user as read. Returns the number of rows updated.
Generate subtasks, polish an issue description, or summarize a sprint cycle using a configured LLM. Falls back to deterministic heuristics when the LLM is unreachable.

Mark an issue in_progress, assign it to the target agent, and optionally forward the task to a configured Windmill/agent webhook. Returns the updated issue state and whether it was dispatched externally.

400.description: Missing/invalid issue_id, invalid agent_target, or prompt >8000 chars

post.description: Update one or more fields on up to 500 issues in a single request (board/list multi-select). Each record is saved through the standard hooks, so the activity audit and realtime SSE fire per record.

data.description: Field updates. Only whitelisted fields are allowed; per-project custom fields use the custom_ prefix.

cycle.description: Cycle record id or null/empty to clear

milestone.description: Milestone record id or null/empty to clear

post.description: Delete up to 500 issues in a single request. Requires an admin or manager role (mirrors the issues collection deleteRule).

get.description: Search issues across every project by title, identifier, status, or priority. Used by the Cmd+K omnibox.

Read the current Discord/Telegram/generic-webhook notification channel configuration. Admin/manager/superuser only. Values come from the notification_settings collection, falling back to process environment.

put.description: Persist Discord/Telegram/generic-webhook notification channel configuration so it applies immediately without a process restart. Admin/agent only.

post.summary: Import Issues from a Plane Export
post.description: Import issues from a Plane workspace CSV export (Workspace Settings > Exports > select project > Export > CSV). Accepts either an array of row objects keyed by Plane's export CSV columns (Name/Title, State, Priority, Labels, Assignees, Start Date, Target Date, Estimate, Description) via `rows`, or the raw CSV export text via `csv`. Idempotent: keyed by Plane issue ID via source_metadata.source_key.

rows.description: Row objects keyed by Plane export column names

csv.description: Raw Plane workspace CSV export text (pasted directly). Parsed server-side.

400.description: Missing project_id / empty rows / too many rows

get.description: Returns the sanitized team of AI agents detected on the host (read from the agent-bridge output). Includes name, provider, runtime, avatar and found flag.
Returns a summary of the local flomaster agent (config presence, provider/model, last session).

post.description: Upserts the detected agents from the bridge into the agents collection (keyed by name).

JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoint implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) over HTTP for autonomous AI agents (Flomaster, Hermes, Cursor, Claude). Exposes tools: list_projects, list_issues, get_issue, create_issue, update_issue, move_issue, add_comment, list_cycles, list_milestones, get_stats. Requires Bearer authentication.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or expired Authorization Bearer token

get.description: Returns all active task execution leases across the workspace to prevent concurrent agent collisions.

post.description: Acquires an exclusive task execution lease on an issue. Returns HTTP 409 Conflict if actively leased by another agent.

409.description: Collision: task leased by another agent

post.description: Extends the expiration TTL and heartbeat for an existing active lease.
Releases an active task execution lease on an issue.
Records agent reasoning traces, tool invocations, and checkpoint events.

get.description: Queries historical telemetry events filtered by agent name, issue ID, or event type.

post.description: Registers an outbound webhook subscription for external orchestrators.

get.description: Lists all registered webhook subscriptions.

post.description: Decomposes a parent issue into a DAG of child tasks with personas and dependency edges.

get.description: Retrieves execution status, ready/blocked nodes, and leases for a task DAG.

post.description: Advances DAG execution by claiming next unblocked task for an agent persona.
Dynamically splits an issue checklist into subtasks with assigned agent personas.
Submits a peer-review verdict or test validation checkpoint for an issue.

get.description: Lists validation checkpoints and quality gate status for an issue.
Deep semantic & full-text workspace knowledge search across issues, comments, telemetry, and validation checkpoints.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of types (issues, comments, telemetry, checkpoints)

post.description: POST endpoint for deep workspace knowledge search with JSON body.

get.description: Analyzes dependency graph, detects cross-project blockers, circular deadlock warnings, and critical path items.
Computes velocity metrics, agent productivity, quality gates, and AI recommendations for sprint/cycle.

post.description: POST endpoint for generating sprint retrospective report with JSON payload.

get.description: Exports a portable project or workspace federation bundle with SHA-256 data integrity checksum.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Optional project filter (exports full workspace if omitted)

post.description: POST endpoint for exporting federation bundle with JSON configuration.
Imports a federation bundle with merge, overwrite, or skip_existing conflict strategy.
Two-way delta synchronization bridge exchanging modified issues and records since timestamp.

get.description: Scans workspace for stale agent leases, rapid failure loops, starved issues, circular locks, and auto-heals if requested.

parameters.name: auto_heal
parameters.description: Automatically repair anomalies and revoke dead leases

post.description: POST endpoint for workflow anomaly detection and auto-healing.

get.description: Calculates Mean Time to Complete (MTTC) per agent persona, validation pass rate %, and throughput forecast.
Query linked branches, commits, pull requests, CI runs, and staged patches for an issue or project.

post.description: Link a branch, commit, PR, or CI run to an issue and auto-update Kanban status.
Stage a unified diff or patch for peer review and automated agent verification.

get.description: Retrieve full patch content and unified diff statistics.

post.description: Handles GitHub/GitLab push, pull_request, and CI webhooks for automated issue triage.

get.description: Aggregated workspace/project git status, active branches, open/merged PRs, and CI pass rate.

200.description: Git status and CI reliability metrics

get.description: Get real-time agent queue saturation, persona queue depth, active task leases, capacity, and estimated clearance time.

200.description: Workload saturation metrics and persona queue depths

post.description: Calculate optimal autonomous agent worker pool allocations per persona based on backlog pressure and queue depth.
Reserve worker slot concurrency capacity with TTL expiration.
Release an active agent worker capacity reservation.
Autonomous self-healing scan to detect and auto-repair expired leases, orphaned DAG subtasks, and stalled statuses.

200.description: Self-healing scan results and applied repairs

get.description: Real-time query latency distribution (p50/p95), SQLite WAL status, and QPS estimation.

post.description: Executes consecutive query latency probes and computes statistical distribution.
Register or update a cluster peer/edge node with role, endpoint, and capabilities.

get.description: List registered cluster nodes with health, role, lag, and quorum status.

post.description: Heartbeat and sync sequence reporting for peers/replicas.

delete.description: Deregister and decommission a cluster node.

get.description: Pull replication delta stream since a sequence ID or vector clock checkpoint.

post.description: Push delta stream with vector clock conflict resolution & split-brain fencing.
Export point-in-time state snapshot bundle for cold-start edge initialization.

get.description: High-availability cluster health, quorum state, term epoch, and leader info.

post.description: Promote replica to primary upon quorum election or manual switchover.
Split-brain fencing token validation & barrier verification.
Two-way offline-first edge SQLite reconciliation & delta merge.

200.description: Reconciliation outcome and updated vector clock

post.description: Register or update an outbound webhook endpoint with HMAC secret, target platform, and event filters.

get.description: List all configured outbound webhook endpoints with delivery stats.
Retrieve specific webhook endpoint configuration.

delete.description: Delete or decommission a webhook endpoint.

post.description: Dispatch webhook event with declarative payload formatting and cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 signing.
Cryptographically verify HMAC-SHA256 signature and enforce 300s replay tolerance.

401.description: Signature mismatch or replay window expired

get.description: Query historical webhook deliveries and audit log.
Get failed webhook messages in the Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) with retry metadata.

200.description: Dead-Letter Queue telemetry and item list

post.description: Replay failed dead-letter queue messages.

delete.description: Purge specific DLQ item or flush entire queue.

get.description: Preview platform-specific payload formatting for Slack, Discord, Telegram, or Agent targets.

200.description: Formatted platform payload and preview signature
